title: Required.
officialText:
Structures occupied for purposes involving explosion hazards shall be provided with explosion control in
compliance with rules of the Commissioner of the Fire Department. Explosion control systems shall be designed and installed in
accordance with the New York City Fire Code.
SECTION MC 311
SMOKE AND HEAT VENTS
